description: Sales tax report for a period (owner or office), shop local dates, from and to inclusive. Uses the shop's basis (shops.setTaxReportBasis) unless basis is given. accrual: invoices sent in the period, with sales, taxable sales, tax billed, and tax collected so far. cash: money collected in the period through Doing Work (payments minus refunds, tips left out), with the tax share of it. Grouped by the tax name, jurisdiction and rate on each invoice. Untaxed sales are one row with no rate. Void invoices are left out. For filing, check the numbers against your own records.
name: taxes_salesReport
